body:
## Code Review

This pull request implements Stage 70 JIT configuration runtime-write remediation for the Windows Hyper-V runner. Based on findings from the fifth pilot, the systemd service configuration was updated to change ProtectHome to read-only and allow write access to /opt/actions-runner so that the runner can write its JIT configuration files. Correspondingly, documentation, scripts, and bundle validation checks were updated. The review feedback suggests hardening the systemd service by explicitly marking /opt/actions-runner/bin and /opt/actions-runner/externals as read-only for defense-in-depth, and expanding the validation regex in validate-bundle.mjs to reject other systemd boolean representations of true (such as on and 1).
